description: Unit tests for Orleans Stateless Worker grains, testing various behaviors including constructor exceptions, activation limits, concurrency, interleaving, and multi-silo deployment scenarios.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerTests
classes.description: A test class containing various unit tests for Orleans Stateless Worker grains.

classes.name: CallbackObserver
classes.description: A private nested class implementing ICallbackGrainObserver for callback synchronization in tests.

methods.name: StatelessWorkerThrowExceptionConstructor
methods.description: Tests that constructing a faulty stateless worker grain throws the expected exceptions.

methods.name: StatelessWorkerActivationsPerSiloDoNotExceedMaxLocalWorkersCount
methods.description: Verifies that the number of local stateless worker activations per silo does not exceed the configured maximum.

methods.name: ManyConcurrentInvocationsOnActivationLimitedStatelessWorkerDoesNotFail
methods.description: Ensures system stability under high concurrent invocations with activation limits.

methods.name: StatelessWorkerFastActivationsDontFailInMultiSiloDeployment
methods.description: Checks that rapid activations across multiple silos do not cause forwarding failures (currently skipped).

methods.name: StatelessWorker_DoesNotThrow_IfMarkedWithMayInterleave
methods.description: Tests that methods marked with MayInterleave are processed concurrently without errors.

methods.name: StatelessWorker_ShouldNotInterleaveCalls_IfMayInterleavePredicatedDoesntMatch
methods.description: Verifies that calls with non-matching MayInterleave predicate are executed sequentially.

methods.name: StatelessWorker_ShouldInterleaveCalls_IfMayInterleavePredicatedMatches
methods.description: Checks that calls with matching MayInterleave predicate are executed concurrently.

methods.name: Signal
methods.description: Method in CallbackObserver class to signal callback invocation.

methods.name: OnCallback
methods.description: Task property for awaiting callback invocation in CallbackObserver.
